# Hannah K

Studio Artist and Motion Designer at DEPT®, creating high-quality digital
campaigns across platforms. I translate creative concepts into polished motion
and static assets — blending design, storytelling, and production — and build
the workflow automation that delivers them at scale.

## About
- Role: Senior Studio Artist, DEPT® (global digital advertising agency) — 4+ years, remote
- Client focus: Meta growth-marketing accounts — Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp (and related Meta surfaces)
- What I do: static & motion ad production; workflow design & optimization; custom automation and AI-integrated post-production; technical onboarding, guidelines, and team training
- Specialties: Figma, design systems, localization at scale (78 languages), motion graphics & 2D animation, AI-integrated workflows, Adobe Creative Cloud
- Education: BFA in Communication Design, New York City College of Technology (City Tech, CUNY), Cum Laude — coursework in UX/UI design, identity design, and motion graphics
- Location: United States (remote)
- Open to: brand / design-systems and design-engineering-adjacent roles, and collaborations

## Selected work
- Scalable Systems for Figma Production — an in-house automation suite that cut localized static-banner production time by roughly 83%. (Case study is password-protected; details available on request.)
- Motion & performance ad work across Meta's family of apps.
